name: qlrisk_simulate_paths
title: Monte Carlo path generation
description: Monte Carlo paths: gbm, ou, cir, heston, vasicek, hull_white, merton_jump. Returns statistics on up to 60 time points, the terminal distribution and a few sample paths. Inputs: process, initial_value, drift, volatility, maturity, num_paths; process parameters (mean reversion, Heston, jumps) in `advanced`. Example: {"process": "gbm", "initial_value": 100, "drift": 0.05, "volatility": 0.2, "maturity": 1, "num_paths": 10000} gives 10000 gbm paths x 252 steps: terminal mean 105.157, std 21.382.
